mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 53 degrees with clear skies near the library and a Waning Gibbous moon overhead. If you are up early, look for the ISS at 5:05 AM traveling from the Northwest over Verona High School toward the Northeast near Home Depot.

The Wisconsin Department of Transportation is hosting public meetings for the US 18/151 Corridor Study, looking at the stretch between Dodgeville and Fitchburg. You can provide feedback at an in-person session at Mount Horeb High School on November 18 or via a virtual meeting on November 19.

There is plenty to do this week, starting with trivia at The Bogey Factory and music at Paddy Mac's today. Tomorrow, bring the family to Main Street Trick or Treat at Hometown Junction Park or check out the Thursday night fun at the ART House.
On October 23, officers made contact with two 13-year-olds riding eMotos on Ashton Drive, resulting in citations for their parents for permitting them to drive a motor vehicle.
Chocolate Heath Crunch is the featured flavor of the day, and our local Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM.
